name: Admin Document List
description: View admin documents with title, client/project association and ordered active-state episodes. The exclusive cycle appears before additive signals, every badge carries its open duration, Solucionar bug is visually prominent, overflow collapses to +N, and documents with no cycle show Por clasificar. Per-row actions remain in the shared Acciones sheet. Responsive layouts keep state context in table or cards; filters and episode behavior are covered by admin-document-state-filters and admin-document-state-workflow.
